summary.zh: 调用万级爬虫与自动化工具
summary.en: Run scrapers and automations from Apify

description.zh:
从 Apify Store 调用现成的爬虫、抓取器与自动化工具提取网站数据。
连接时需要 Apify API Token。
description.en:
Call ready-made scrapers, crawlers, and automation tools from Apify Store to extract website data.
Requires an Apify API token.

authHint.zh: 需要 Apify API Token，连接时按提示填写。
authHint.en: Requires an Apify API token; you'll be asked for it when connecting.
